Method of Attack: Malicious USB devices mailed in packages to deploy ransomware
USB devices register as Human Interface Device (HID) Keyboard to inject keystrokes
Installation of malware payloads including ransomware (BlackMatter, REvil) using tools like Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Carbanak malware, Griffon backdoor, PowerShell scripts
Attack Vector: Malicious USB devices mailed via United States Postal Service (USPS) and United Parcel Service (UPS)
Impersonation of Amazon and US Department of Health & Human Services (HHS) to trick targets into opening packages and connecting USB drives
